name: Ruckus ZoneDirector / SmartZone (RUCKUS-ZD-WLAN-MIB)
_comment: ruckusZDWLANAPTable, entry 1.3.6.1.4.1.25053.1.2.2.1.1.2.1.1, indexed by the AP MAC. Ruckus is the one vendor here that publishes a per-AP client count directly (ruckusZDWLANAPNumSta, .15), so no summing is needed. ruckusZDWLANAPDescription is the AP's configured name; the MIB has no separate name column. Column numbers are the Entry's, which the published MIB does not list separately — ruckusZDWLANAPMacAddr appearing as ...2.1.1 is that Entry, and the real index column is ...2.1.1.1.
